list point

seed.request: an api key reminder list with service name, expiry date and days left, warning when under 30

start:
app "API keys" key plum
table apikey name text, service text, expires date, sent bool
let soon = count(apikey where sent = no and expires < today)
soon "due in 30 days" head color if(soon > 0, warn, good)
each apikey where sent = no sort expires as k
  row card gap 2 tap edit k
    toggle k.sent
    stack grow
      k.name bold
      k.service faint
    if k.expires < today
      "Over by" today - k.expires faint color bad
    else
      "Expires in" plural(k.expires - today, "day") faint
form apikey, "Add key"

seed.request: a zakat calculator where i enter gold, cash and business stock, nisab is a setting and it shows zakat due at 2.5 percent

start:
app "Zakat and tip" calc slate
setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  "People" people faint
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * tip / 100) big

start:
app "Attendance" users ocean
table student name text
table absent student ref student
state d date = today
state adding bool = no
let away = count(absent on d)
row align center gap 1
  button "<" tap set d = d - 1
  dayname(d) monthday(d) monthname(d) bold
  if d >= today
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set d = d + 1
if count(student) = 0
  stack card gap 2
    "No students yet" head
    "Add the names in your class, then tap a name to mark that child absent." color muted
else
  stack gap 0
    count(student) - away "of" count(student) "present" big
    if away > 0
      away "absent today" color muted
    else
      "Everyone is here" color good
  grid 3 gap 1
    each student sort name as s
      stack radius 10 pad 1 gap 0 fill if(count(s.absent on d) > 0, bad, soft) tap toggle s.absent on d
        s.name bold
        if count(s.absent on d) > 0
          "Absent" small
        else
          "Present" faint
  "Tap a name to mark absent. Everyone starts present." faint
  section "This month"
    each student sort count(it.absent month of d) desc top 5 as s
      row
        s.name grow
        plural(count(s.absent month of d), "day") "absent" color muted
button if(adding, "Close", "Add student") tap set adding = not adding
if adding
  form student, "Save student"

start:
app "Budget" wallet slate
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Groceries|Bills|Transport|Eating_out|Health|Other = Groceries
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no
state d new spend
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
let now_month = monthname(m) = monthname(today)
let day = if(now_month, monthday(today), monthdays(m))
let left = budget - spent
row align center gap 1 bar
  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)
  monthname(m) bold grow align center
  if now_month
    box width 44
  else
    button ">" tap set m = addmonths(m, 1)
stack card gap 3
  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted
  row gap 1 align end
    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 4
    rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "Day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack card gap 2
  "Spending through the month" head
  row gap 3
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1, 16, 2 fill accent
      "Spent so far" faint
    row gap 1
      draw 16, 4 width 16
        rect 0, 1.5, 16, 1 fill muted
      "Even pace" faint
  plot 1..monthdays(m), 0..max(budget, spent) axes gridlines
    line 1, 0, monthdays(m), budget stroke muted thick 1
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days month of m
        if monthday(it) <= day
          pt monthday(it), sum(spend.amount month of m where at < it + 1)
    circle day, spent, 1 fill accent
    tick 1, "1"
    tick round(monthdays(m) / 2), round(monthdays(m) / 2)
    tick monthdays(m), monthdays(m)
  spent "spent by day" day "against an even pace of" round(budget * day / monthdays(m)) faint
stack card gap 3
  row
    "By category" head grow
    "Tap to filter" faint
  if spent = 0
    "No spending this month yet." color muted
  each spend month of m by category sort amount desc
    stack gap 1 tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
      row
        it.key grow bold
        round(sum(it.amount) * 100 / spent) "%" faint
        sum(it.amount)
      draw 100, 2
        rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 2 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted) radius 1
row gap 2 align center
  if(cat = "", "All expenses", cat) head grow
  if cat != ""
    button "Show all" tap set cat = ""
each spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day as g empty "Nothing here. Expenses you add show up here, newest first."
  row
    g.key bold faint grow
    sum(g.amount) faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.what
        r.category faint
      r.amount bold

app "Workouts" dumbbell ink
table lift exercise text, kg num 0.. = 0 unit "kg", sets num 1..20 = 3, reps num 1..100
state ex text = last(lift.exercise)
state adding bool = no
state d new lift keep
let vol = sum(lift week, it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let before = sum(lift prev week where weekday(at) <= weekday(today), it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let trained = count(days week, count(lift on it) > 0)
let hi = max(lift.kg last 35 days where exercise = ex)
let lo = min(lift.kg last 35 days where exercise = ex)
row bar
  button if(adding, "Close", "Log exercise") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
if adding
  stack card gap 3
    field d
    "Use 0 kg for bodyweight moves like push-ups." faint
    button "Save set" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
row gap 1
  each days week
    stack grow gap 1 align center
      dayname(it) tiny color if(it = today, ink, muted)
      box height 36 radius 8 fill if(count(lift on it) > 0, accent, soft)
        it if(count(lift on it) > 0, ", trained", ", rest") opacity 0
stack gap 1
  if count(lift today) > 0
    plural(count(lift today), "exercise") "today," sum(lift today, it.sets) "sets" head
  else
    "No training yet today" head
  if trained > 0
    plural(trained, "day") "this week," round(vol / 100) / 10 "t moved" color muted
    if before > 0
      round((vol - before) * 100 / before) "% compared with the same days last week" faint
  else
    "Nothing logged this week yet. Tap Log exercise after your first set." color muted
  if count(lift) > 0
    button "Repeat last set" tap add lift exercise = last(lift.exercise), kg = last(lift.kg), sets = last(lift.sets), reps = last(lift.reps)
stack card gap 3
  "Progress" head
  if count(lift) = 0
    "Your progress shows here once you have logged an exercise twice." color muted
  else
    scroll gap 1
      each lift last 60 days by exercise
        button it.key fill if(ex = it.key, ink, surface) tap set ex = it.key
    if count(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex) < 2
      "Log" ex "twice to see a line." color muted
    else
      row gap 3
        stack gap 0
          hi "kg" head
          "best set, 5 weeks" faint
        stack gap 0
          count(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex) "times" head
          "logged" faint
      plot 0..35, lo..hi axes gridlines
        poly stroke accent thick 2
          each lift last 35 days where exercise = ex sort at
            pt 35 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.kg
        circle 35 - (now - last(lift.at where exercise = ex)) / 1d, last(lift.kg where exercise = ex), 1 fill accent
        tick 1, today - 34
        tick 34, "Today"
      "Latest:" last(lift.kg where exercise = ex) "kg for" last(lift.reps where exercise = ex) "reps. Weights in kg." faint

each lift last 14 days by day as g empty "Nothing logged in the last two weeks."
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      r.exercise grow bold
      r.sets "x" r.reps color muted
      r.kg "kg"

start:
app "Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
state q text = ""
state writing bool = no
let wrote = count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0)
row bar
  button if(writing, "Close", "Write") fill if(writing, soft, accent) tap set writing = not writing
stack gap 0
  if count(entry today) > 0
    "You wrote today" head
  else
    "Nothing written today yet" head
  if streak(entry) > 0
    plural(streak(entry), "day") "in a row," wrote "of the last 14 days" faint
if writing
  stack card gap 3
    "How are you feeling?" head
    row gap 1
      each ["Rough", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
        stack grow gap 1 align center radius 10 pad 1 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft) tap set d.mood = index + 1
          draw 20, 12 width 28
            each 1..5 as b
              rect 4 * b - 4, 12 - 2.4 * b, 3, 2.4 * b fill if(b <= index + 1, ink, edge) radius 0.6
          it small
    field d.note "What happened today?"
    row gap 2
      "Saved on this device only" faint grow
      button "Save entry" fill accent tap save d then set writing = no
stack card gap 3
  row
    "Mood, last 30 days" head grow
    "This week" round(avg(entry.mood week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
  if count(entry last 30 days) < 2
    "Write on two days to see your mood line." color muted
  else
    plot 0..30, 1..5 axes gridlines
      poly stroke accent thick 2
        each entry last 30 days sort at
          pt 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood
      each entry last 30 days
        circle 30 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.mood, 1 fill accent
      ytick 5, "Great"
      ytick 3, "Okay"
      ytick 1, "Rough"
      tick 1, today - 29
      tick 29, "Today"
    "Last week averaged" round(avg(entry.mood prev week) * 10) / 10 "of 5" faint
"Recent" head
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
if q = "" and count(entry) = 0
  "No entries yet. Tap Write, pick a mood and write a line." color muted
each entry where has(note, q) by day as g
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    stack card gap 1 tap edit r swipe remove r
      if(r.mood >= 4, "Good day", if(r.mood = 3, "Okay day", "Hard day")) faint color if(r.mood >= 4, good, if(r.mood = 3, muted, warn))
      r.note

start:
app "To do" list ink
table task title text, due date?, done bool, tag pick Home|Work|Other = Home
state adding bool = no
state showdone bool = no
state d new task
let late = count(task where done = no and due < today)
let open = count(task where done = no)
row bar
  button if(adding, "Close", "Add task") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
if adding
  stack card gap 3
    field d.title "Task"
    field d.due "Due"
    choice d.tag
    button "Save task" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
stack gap 0
  plural(open, "task") "open" head
  if late > 0
    "Late:" plural(late, "task") "past the due date" bold color bad
  else
    "Nothing is late" color good
if open = 0
  "All done. Add a task when something new comes up." color muted
each task where done = no sort due as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow gap 0
      t.title bold
      if t.due < today
        "Late, was due" t.due "·" t.tag faint color bad
      else
        if t.due = today
          "Due today ·" t.tag faint color warn
        else
          t.due "·" t.tag faint
row gap 2 align center
  "Done" count(task where done = yes) head grow
  button if(showdone, "Hide", "Show") tap set showdone = not showdone
if showdone
  each task where done = yes as t
    row gap 2 swipe remove t
      toggle t.done
      t.title color muted grow
remind "You have tasks due today" at 8:00 if count(task where done = no and due = today) > 0
